seo.title: Smarttnails by Ardak Aldanazarova — manicure and pedicure in Astana
seo.description: Nail artist Ardak: natural manicure, gel polish, French tips, extensions and pedicure in Astana. Rated 5.0 on 2GIS. Book online in a minute.

hero.subtitle: Natural results, flawless cuticles and zero pain. Nail artist Ardak, Smarttnails studio in Astana.

natural.title: Natural
natural.text: A thin, neat finish that looks like your own well-kept nails.

cuticle.title: Clean cuticles
cuticle.text: Careful prep with no hangnails, so your polish stays fresh for longer.

painless.title: Painless
painless.text: Gentle e-file manicure: no cuts, no discomfort.

sterile.title: Sterile
sterile.text: Tools are fully sterilised and opened from a sealed pouch in front of you.

gallery.hint: Hover or tap to pause the feed

services.title: Services and {accent}
services.subtitle: Pick several services at once — time and price are calculated for you.

gel.name: Manicure + gel polish
gel.desc: E-file manicure, nail levelling and long-lasting single-colour gel.

hardware.name: Manicure, no polish
hardware.desc: E-file cuticle care, shaping, treatment and oil.

french.name: Manicure + French
french.desc: Classic or coloured French in any shape, from soft square to almond.

extension.name: Gel extensions
extension.desc: Length and shape of your choice, polish and design included.

pedicure.name: Pedicure with gel polish
pedicure.desc: Foot and toe care finished with gel polish.

kids.name: Kids' manicure
kids.desc: Gentle care with no e-file and no filing on the skin.

paraffin.name: Paraffin hand bath
paraffin.desc: Deep moisture and soft skin. The perfect add-on to any manicure.

wear.q: How long does the polish last?
wear.a: Usually 3–4 weeks. I recommend a refill every 3 weeks so your nails always look fresh.

late.a: Message me on WhatsApp. Up to 15 minutes late is fine. Any later and we may need to reschedule or shorten the service.

cancel.q: How do I cancel or reschedule?
cancel.a: In “My bookings” on this site or via WhatsApp — please at least 3 hours in advance.

payment.a: Cash, card transfer or QR code.

kids.a: Yes — gently, with no e-file on the skin. Kids are welcome to come with a parent.
